argv.description: The first or only command: its executable followed by its literal arguments, such as ["git","status"]. Always an array, also when then is given.

then.description: Commands to run after argv, each an argument vector like argv, in order and in the same cwd, each only if the previous command exited successfully.

cwd.description: Existing workspace-relative directory, or . for the root.

timeout_ms.description: Milliseconds each command may run. Defaults to 120000; values below 10000 are raised to 10000.
